svg.title: Imported campus walk-surface graph and destination approaches
svg.desc: Unity scene-coordinate plan generated from the imported campus path mesh. Building footprints are obstacles; purple markers are first-floor prototype labs and red markers are inferred ground-floor approaches.
svg.text: Campus route graph from imported Unity geometry
1,576 nodes · 4,748 walkable edges · weighted Dijkstra · building clearance applied; inferred links and facility assignments require field verification
Scene coordinates; route distances are shortest within this graph. Generic building names, front gates, and unlabelled destinations are inferred from geometry.
